question: Can physics-guided causal query births turn precise but incomplete TAPNext++ tracks into a bias-aware recursive discrepancy belief that improves disjoint hidden Deform360 identities without regressing below the unchanged physical/persistence backbone?
claim_boundary: The source phase may establish provider competence and source transfer only. A state-of-the-art claim additionally requires a passed source gate, an untouched object-disjoint target cohort, authoritative evaluator parity, local reproduction of the strongest eligible baseline, and improvement on both primary metrics.

amendments.reason: A separately owned source-only campaign opened 12 physical objects after the original 82-object exclusion union was frozen. None overlapped the original union, so all 12 were added before this protocol selected a source or target cohort.

The source campaign opened or technically dispositioned all 18 queued physical objects, not only the 12 objects retained in its final cohort. Six queued objects were absent from the 94-object union and were added before this protocol selected a source or target cohort.

The initial protocol named Deform360 but omitted an immutable dataset revision and an executable metadata-only candidate rule. The exact public snapshot and deterministic 36-object staging rule were bound before cohort selection, episode payload download, tracker execution, or provider outcomes.

Implementation review found that the preregistered graph-mode position/velocity wording exceeded the source-supported candidate. Before cohort locking or provider outcomes, V1 was narrowed to the already source-motivated recursive readout-discrepancy belief: birth-relative motion cancels a static birth-wave gauge, metric covariance controls the update, and the physical and persistence backbones remain unchanged. A dynamically admissible simulator-state update remains a separate future arm.

The first target-free physical-backbone smoke stopped before simulation because the physical runner invoked the generic fresh-source validator without the dynamic protocol's exact admission configuration. The runner was changed to use the already tested dynamic admission normalizer. No physical rollout, tracker execution, provider result, future object payload, or metric was opened. The deterministic cohort membership is unchanged, and the cohort lock is regenerated only to bind the corrected code and protocol hashes.

data_source.candidate_metadata_rule: After the 100-object hash exclusion, retain objects whose pinned metadata has at least one sequence and only yes/no bimanual values. Choose the numerically first 12 in each fixed public-name stratum: name contains cloth; name does not contain cloth and numeric prefix is below 138; name does not contain cloth and numeric prefix is at least 138. Interleave the three strata by rank.
data_source.candidate_episode_rule: episode zero, which is the lowest metadata-listed episode for every staged candidate

fresh_object_boundary.episode_rule: lowest source-admissible episode ID per selected object
fresh_object_boundary.partition_rule: deterministic category-stratified round robin after hash exclusion and source admission; source and target partitions are locked together before source outcomes are opened
fresh_object_boundary.technical_failure_policy: retain in denominator without retry, replacement, or target-informed substitution

camera_panel.eligibility: calibration, causal RGB, depth, and object mask are present and frame-zero projected candidate support is nonzero
camera_panel.selection: deterministic greedy coverage-plus-angular-diversity score using only frame-zero geometry and calibration; ties use lexical camera name

query_schedule.candidate_source: frame-zero material identities deterministically attached to the physical graph before outcomes are opened
query_schedule.selection_objective: greedy D-optimal graph-mode information gain multiplied by clipped predicted motion, subject to multiview visibility and spatial-separation constraints

birth_association.candidate_source: current causal object-mask pixels with valid depth near the physical projection
birth_association.association_score: pixel displacement plus camera-depth agreement with the physical proposal

claim_bearing_observation.two_view_role: tracking continuity and association proposal only; never a claim-bearing discrepancy-likelihood row
claim_bearing_observation.shared_bias_representation: one coherent 3-D low-rank factor per update interval, not an independent per-row variance floor
claim_bearing_observation.correlation_group: one material-identity trajectory within one birth wave
claim_bearing_observation.prior_reliability: TAPNext++ visibility, mask support, depth support, reprojection consistency, view redundancy, and association entropy only
claim_bearing_observation.innovation_processing: exactly once through the covariance-aware Student-t robust discrepancy update

state_update.physical_backbone: strongest source-selected physical or exact-persistence backbone, selected without future outcomes
state_update.candidate_coordinates: recursive global-plus-local RBF readout-discrepancy belief centered on dynamically scheduled material identities
state_update.physical_state_update: not performed in V1; physical and persistence trajectories remain immutable candidate backbones
state_update.shared_camera_bias: a static bias common to a birth wave is canceled by birth-relative displacement; unresolved coherent bias remains represented by the observation belief and conservative covariance rather than being relabeled as physical state
state_update.contact_action_anchor: the known action and physical rollout determine query motion support and scheduling but do not manufacture perception reliability
state_update.unidentifiable_modes: retain the selected physical or persistence backbone exactly
state_update.readout_discrepancy: applied additively only after the pairwise correspondence and robust covariance-aware update
state_update.exact_fallback: byte-identical selected backbone whenever observation, identifiability, or regret admission fails

candidate_update.measurement: physical position at query birth plus observed multiview displacement from birth to update
candidate_update.backbone_selector: minimum current sparse symmetric Chamfer between physical and persistence, with physical winning an exact tie; insufficient support selects persistence
candidate_update.innovation_use: processed exactly once by the covariance-aware Student-t robust update
candidate_update.future_application: the posterior discrepancy mean is added to the selected readout over the next interval; its marginal variance is retained separately

source_provider_gate.covariance_calibration: leave-one-object-out scalar conformal inflation fitted on the other source objects
source_provider_gate.pass_action: freeze the discrepancy update and baseline-relative regret gate before opening any sealed target object
source_provider_gate.fail_action: stop this provider version without changing queries, births, cameras, thresholds, covariance, or gates on the opened source cohort

source_assimilation_gate.evaluation: only future material identities disjoint from every measurement identity
source_assimilation_gate.regret_guard: source-cross-fitted upper confidence bound on candidate loss minus unchanged-backbone loss; nonnegative or unavailable bounds select exact fallback

sealed_target_gate.claim_if_all_pass: better than the locally reproduced state of the art on the locked fresh-object Deform360 cohort under the authoritative evaluator

forbidden: opening held-v8 target, query, score, barrier, or outcome artifacts
selecting target episodes from future object motion or target errors
weakening the prior TAPNext++ 75% support gate on its opened case
using two-view triangulations as claim-bearing discrepancy updates
using state innovation to manufacture prior perception reliability
scoring any material identity used by any query birth wave
tuning tracker, queries, camera panel, covariance, likelihood, or gates after source outcomes
opening sealed target outcomes when either source gate fails
calling fixed candidate metrics official Deform360 parity without the authoritative evaluator
